recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to light gray (#f5f5f5).
2. Add title 'How to Kernelize SVM' at top center in bold red (#c00000), sans-serif.
3. Add yellow circle (#ffd700) at top right with black text '34'.
4. Draw large cream rectangle (#ffffe0) below title spanning most of slide width.
5. Inside cream box, add Lagrangian equation in blue: \mathscr{L}_D(\alpha) = \sum_{i=1}^N \alpha_i - \frac{1}{2} \sum_{j=1}^N \sum_{i=1}^N \alpha_i \alpha_j y_i y_j X_i^T X_j
6. Add two side-by-side boxes: left with W = \sum_{i=1}^N \alpha_i y_i X_i, right with b = -\frac{1}{2} [\max_{i:y_i=-1} W^T X_i + \min_{i:y_i=+1} W^T X_i], both in blue math font.
7. Add orange/salmon box (#ffcc99) with text 'Class of vector Z => sign(W^T Z + b)'.
8. Below cream box, add 'Remember :' section with blue header.
9. Add three rows: 'Mapping' in red bold, then text; math line with X_i^T X_j => φ(X_i)^T φ(X_j); 'Kernelization' in red bold, then text with K(X_i^T, X_j).
10. Add small black cursor icon near bottom left.
11. Add black strip at very bottom edge.
